instance_rule: replicate 0, next larger spatial layout (R2/T20), then four-robot bottleneck layout (R4/T40); fixed before outcomes
selection_rule: Eligible = valid and executed with zero strategy errors. Compare fixed-iteration and 2.4-second means on all four development instances; retain a generated policy only if its timed mean improves both manual pool and deterministic-kernel group by at least 1 model-time unit. Otherwise retain manual pool pending mechanism judgment. No significance claim.
stop_rule: At most two generations, one candidate per generation; one optional engineering fix per candidate within six actual requests; stop on unavailable useful reference action space or no actionable feedback. No automatic retries.
independent_check: None: all four instances are development feedback/selection inputs; no independent validation claimed.
